purpose: Defines the responsibilities and permissions of each actor in doc-link, the logical script operations, the Skill-script connection rules, and the storage of management state.
summary: Responsibility and permission table for caller, Skill, scripts, information-generation AI, search AI and user
Logical operations provided by scripts with inputs, results and failure promises
Rules connecting Skills and scripts, including version and state checks that reject disallowed transitions
Information-generation AI receives only document content and the stated limit, never the internal upper limit
Impact notification lists changed documents and known referrers mechanically with no AI judgment
Recovery behavior when DLID assignment fails partway: written DLIDs are kept and reported
All files are created inside the project; temporary files go under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/
Management state stored as JSON under .doc-link/, split into per-document information and per-key confirmed ToC
Deterministic byte-identical output and unchanged files are not rewritten
tasks: Defining actor permissions and write restrictions
Implementing DLID assignment and failure handling
Designing AI generation input and validation boundaries
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
